payload.text: For hv, cldr-vc's F8, 2026-11-04: devbin's formula finish_ruby writes the install manifest as one line of 131 columns (with a 40-hex commit), over brew style's 118. So a tap whose CI runs brew style or brew audit goes red at publish. Cldr's tap carries --except-cops Layout/LineLength until devbin wraps the line. pplr 2.0.0's formula has the same line, unseen because homebrew-pplr has no CI, and ccusage's tap has style and audit off for devbin's formula:424. The fix is devbin's.
